body:
Adds `research/friction-twin` (follow-up to `backlash-twin`): a twin with no dry friction, or Coulomb-only friction, predicts the PI loop converges, but a stiction drop `fs−fc` makes the real loop stick-slip. Includes 7 tests, a reproducible experiment script with recorded results, a white paper, the README bullet and the `site/projects.json` entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Negative and out-of-model results (bistable starts, non-sinusoidal cycle, no closed form for the gain-dependent constant) are marked in the paper.
